caption:
Here's the deal: Workit takes no commission during launch. Agree a price with a verified worker nearby, and every rand goes straight to them — cash or EFT, once the job's done.

No sign-up fee, no cut, no middleman. Both sides are ID-verified, every job has a safety toolkit (doorstep start code, trusted-contact share, SOS), and you rate each other after. That's how trust gets built, one job at a time.

Post a job or find work, free during launch 👉 workitsa.co.za
